items.author: brummie_dan
items.title: Chimney come down on Ashbourne Terrace in the wind??
items.body: Anyone else hear that bang about half nine? Chimney stack off no.41 has gone straight through the roof of 43. Fire brigade were there, nobody hurt thank god. Family at 43 are out. There's slates all over the pavement and the front of 43 has a big crack over the bay window. Anyone know what happens now?

items.author: Moseley_Mick
items.body: Terrible. I've got two acrow props in the garage from when I did my kitchen, happy to go round and put them under the bay ceiling in 43 so it doesn't get any worse overnight. Just need someone to let me in.

items.author: JoJo_KH
items.body: My cousin's a builder and he says these Victorian terraces are built like tanks, it'll look worse than it is. Main thing is the kids walk past there to St Dunstan's in the morning, is the path ok??

items.author: Priya_at_43
items.body: Thank you all for the messages. We're at my sister's in Hall Green. The council came out about 11 and put tape across our front garden and said their dangerous structures person would come in the morning, no time given. Mrs Doherty at 45 refused to leave, she's 84 and says she's slept through worse. Can someone who knows about this say if she is actually safe in there? And is the pavement ok to use?

items.author: Moseley_Mick
items.body: Priya I'll be round at 9 with the props and my lad, if you can drop a key over that'd be great. Better to do something than wait all day for the council. Will also have a look at the loft from inside 43 while we're there.

items.author: Ulrike_K
items.title: Ashbourne Terr. 07:05, from pavement opposite
items.body: No.41: approx. 1.2m of stack still standing, leaning toward 43, pots gone, mortar visibly washed out at the base. Could go any time in more wind (Met Office: gusts 50mph again this afternoon). No.43: front roof slope holed, approx. 2-3m2, debris in front bedroom presumably. Stepped crack in brickwork from bay head up to first floor window cill, 5-10mm wide. Bay head looks dropped, maybe 20mm, lintel not visible under render. Loose slates on 43 and 45 gutter line directly over the footway. Council tape only across front garden of 43, NOT the pavement. Party wall 43/45: could not see from front. 45 front elevation looks undamaged, but stack of 41 sits on the 41/43 party wall, not 45.

items.author: Gary_41
items.title: please read
items.body: Ulrike, I know you're an engineer and I saw you on the forum before. Please don't say anything on there but we had both chimney breasts taken out downstairs and in the back bedroom in spring 2024, Tomasz did it, he said gallows brackets were enough and we never got building regs sign-off. I'm terrified that's why it came down and the insurance will refuse everything. Can we talk privately before you post anything?

items.author: KH_Residents_Admin
items.title: Bin collection days changing from 16 November
items.body: Heads up from the council newsletter: from Monday 16 November collections on the streets east of the High Street move to Tuesdays. Green bins stay fortnightly. Please don't shoot the messenger.

items.author: sallyann_b
items.title: Lost: grey tabby, answers to Biscuit
items.body: Biscuit hasn't come home since Thursday night. Grey tabby with a white bib, blue collar, microchipped. We're near the top of Institute Road. Please check sheds and garages!
